# Module `env`

env - read and write the process environment.

Thin wrappers over the runtime's `__vyb_env_*` functions in
`runtime/vyb_runtime.c`. A lynx-style browser reads HTTP_PROXY / HOME / TERM
here instead of hard-coding them. `env_get` returns "" when a variable is
unset; `env_set` / `env_unset` return 0 on success (the change applies to this
process and any children it spawns).
